name: Offbeat Kashmir & Gurez
description: Village stays, riverside pauses, and a week with room to wander.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Meet your arranged transfer and settle into your stay. Keep the day flexible around arrival and rest.
places: Dal Lake boulevard: a relaxed waterfront stretch
Old Srinagar: an optional locally guided lane walk on non-transfer days
experiences: Kahwa and time to settle into the valley’s rhythm
An artisan demonstration by prior appointment, with no obligation to buy

itinerary.title: Into the quieter valley
itinerary.description: Drive via Bandipora towards Gurez if the pass is open and permissions are in place. Pause along the way and settle into a village stay.
places: Dawar: village lanes around the overnight base
Habba Khatoon surroundings: a riverside viewpoint when access allows
experiences: A locally accompanied village walk with residents’ permission for photographs
Time by the Kishanganga with a picnic arranged in advance

itinerary.title: Village paths & river views
itinerary.description: Spend the day around Dawar with time for the river, village lanes, and local conversations. Visits are by consent and the day is kept unhurried.

experiences: A locally accompanied village walk with residents’ permission for photographs

itinerary.title: A little further into the valley
itinerary.description: Explore the Tulail side by road with short optional walks. Your final route depends on permissions, weather, and the group’s needs.
places: Tulail Valley: selected villages on an approved out-and-back route
Roadside viewpoints chosen with the local guide
experiences: A picnic stop away from traffic with all waste carried back
Village conversations by invitation; no entry into homes is assumed

itinerary.title: Back towards the Sind Valley
itinerary.description: Return over the pass and continue towards a riverside stay in the Sind Valley. This is a travel day; stops depend on road conditions.

Sonamarg or Naranag: choose one branch of the valley rather than combining both
experiences: A riverside break with time to look around
A short guided walk only on an approved, open trail

extensions.title: One more Pahalgam valley day
extensions.description: Request two nights for a slower Pahalgam stay, choosing Aru or Betaab on separate outings rather than rushing both. This may change the main route; local transport, entry charges, hotel and extra cost are quoted separately.

extensions.title: Southern springs with an overnight
extensions.description: Discuss a separate Kokernag or Daksum-area night so the southern valley has its own time. The overnight base, road access, heating and return route need confirmation rather than being added to a busy transfer day.
